svg.title: How Sync works
svg.desc: When an organisation publishes a passport, the hosted platform issues a signed credential describing the published sections. Its SHA-256 fingerprint is written by the organisation's Universal Profile, through a controller with SETDATA, to its own storage under a data key derived from the product. A verifier reads the fingerprint from the chain, hashes the credential, compares the two, and then compares the live passport data with the sections sealed in the credential.
svg.text: setData by the profile, via a controller with SETDATA
1. Read the fingerprint from the profile with getData(key). None there means nothing was published: unverified, not invalid.
2. Hash the active credential and compare. A different value means the record does not match the credential: invalid.
3. Compare the live passport data with the sections sealed in the credential. Values changed since publishing: invalid.
A change of visibility alone is reported, not treated as tampering.
